# nginx — 2013 high-value CVEs (CVSS>=7, CISA KEV, Exploit-DB, or SSVC exploitation active/poc)

Full records for all 4 nginx CVEs of 2013 are in `data/cve/vendors/nginx/2013.jsonl`.

### CVE-2013-2028
- Assigner: redhat | Published: 2013-07-18 | Updated: 2024-08-06 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 25499: Nginx 1.3.9 < 1.4.0 - Denial of Service (PoC) (dos/linux, 2013-05-17, verified=0)
- Exploit-DB 25775: Nginx 1.3.9 < 1.4.0 - Chuncked Encoding Stack Buffer Overflow (Metasploit) (remote/linux, 2013-05-28, verified=1)
- Exploit-DB 26737: Nginx 1.3.9/1.4.0 (x86) - Brute Force (remote/linux_x86, 2013-07-11, verified=0)
- Exploit-DB 32277: Nginx 1.4.0 (Generic Linux x64) - Remote Overflow (remote/linux_x86-64, 2014-03-15, verified=0)

The ngx_http_parse_chunked function in http/ngx_http_parse.c in nginx 1.3.9 through 1.4.0 allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (crash) and execute arbitrary code via a chunked Transfer-Encoding request with a large chunk size, which triggers an integer signedness error and a stack-based buffer overflow.

Affected:
- n/a / n/a: affected n/a

### CVE-2013-4547
- Assigner: redhat | Published: 2013-11-23 | Updated: 2024-08-06 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 38846: Nginx 1.1.17 - URI Processing SecURIty Bypass (remote/multiple, 2013-11-19, verified=1)

nginx 0.8.41 through 1.4.3 and 1.5.x before 1.5.7 allows remote attackers to bypass intended restrictions via an unescaped space character in a URI.
